faqs.question: What is the Wi-Fi password for campus networks?
faqs.answer: Connect to 'Vasavi-Student-WiFi' and log in with your Student Portal Roll Number and password. MAC registration is required at the IT Helpdesk.

faqs.question: How do I apply for a duplicate Student ID card?
faqs.answer: Submit an application at the Student Affairs Section along with a copy of the police FIR / lost report and fee payment receipt of INR 200.

faqs.question: Can I apply for Core Tier companies after getting placed in a Mass Tier company?
faqs.answer: Yes. As per Placement Policy §4.2, students placed in Mass Tier companies are allowed up to 2 attempts for Core or Dream Tier placement drives.
